<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?><record_update table="sys_script_include"><sys_script_include action="INSERT_OR_UPDATE"><access>public</access><active>false</active><api_name>x_ustgl_insighti_0.generateNextBestAction</api_name><caller_access/><client_callable>true</client_callable><description/><mobile_callable>false</mobile_callable><name>generateNextBestAction</name><sandbox_callable>false</sandbox_callable><script><![CDATA[var generateNextBestAction = Class.create();
generateNextBestAction.prototype = Object.extendsObject(global.AbstractAjaxProcessor, {

    generateNBAT: function() {
        var incSys = this.getParameter('sysparm_inc_sys_id');
        var kbRpSysId = gs.getProperty('x_ustgl_insighti_0.search.kb.rp_sys_id');
        var kbContextId = gs.getProperty('x_ustgl_insighti_0.search.kb.context_id');

        var incRpSysId = gs.getProperty('x_ustgl_insighti_0.search.incident.rp_sys_id');
        var incContextId = gs.getProperty('x_ustgl_insighti_0.search.incident.context_id');
        var gr_inc = new GlideRecordSecure('incident');
        gr_inc.addQuery('sys_id', incSys);
        gr_inc.query();
        if (gr_inc.next()) {
            var short_description = (gr_inc.getValue('short_description') || '').trim();
            var description = (gr_inc.getValue('description') || '').trim();
            var finalText = short_description && description ? (short_description.toLowerCase() === description.toLowerCase() ? short_description : short_description + ' ' + description) : (short_description || description);
            if (!this.validateIncidentContent(finalText)) {
                return "ERROR: There is not enough issue information to generate NBA. Please provide clearer issue details.";
            }
        }

        var searchPayload = JSON.stringify({
            rpSysId: kbRpSysId,
            searchContextConfigId: kbContextId,
            searchTerm: finalText
        });

        var incidentpayload = JSON.stringify({
            rpSysId: incRpSysId,
            searchContextConfigId: incContextId,
            searchTerm: finalText
        });

        var kbContent = '';
        try {
            var endpoint = gs.getProperty('azure_openai_endpoint');
            var apiKey = gs.getProperty('azure_openai_key');
            var model = gs.getProperty('azure_openai_model');
            var aiClient = new sn_ws.RESTMessageV2();
            var aiIncident = new sn_ws.RESTMessageV2();

            aiClient.setEndpoint(gs.getProperty("x_ustgl_insighti_0.now_url"));
            aiClient.setHttpMethod("POST");
            aiClient.setRequestHeader("Content-Type", "application/json");
            aiClient.setRequestHeader("Accept", "application/json");

            // FIXED: credentials must be string: "username:password"
            var encodedAuth = gs.base64Encode(gs.getProperty("x_ustgl_insighti_0.auth"));

            aiClient.setRequestHeader("Authorization", "Basic " + encodedAuth);
            aiClient.setRequestBody(searchPayload);

            var aiResponse = aiClient.execute();
            var aiResponseBody = aiResponse.getBody();
            var aiResult = JSON.parse(aiResponseBody);
            var searchResults = aiResult.result && aiResult.result.search && aiResult.result.search.searchResults;

            // Ai seach for past incidents
            aiIncident.setEndpoint(gs.getProperty("x_ustgl_insighti_0.now_url"));
            aiIncident.setHttpMethod("POST");
            aiIncident.setRequestHeader("Content-Type", "application/json");
            aiIncident.setRequestHeader("Accept", "application/json");
            aiIncident.setRequestHeader("Authorization", "Basic " + encodedAuth);
            aiIncident.setRequestBody(incidentpayload);

            var incidentResponse = aiIncident.execute();
            var incidentResponseBody = incidentResponse.getBody();
            var incidentResult;
            try {
                incidentResult = JSON.parse(incidentResponseBody);
            } catch (err) {
                incidentResult = {};
            }
            var incidentSearchResults = incidentResult.result && incidentResult.result.search && incidentResult.result.search.searchResults;
            var incidentContent = '';
            if (incidentSearchResults && incidentSearchResults.length > 0) {
                incidentContent = "Relevant Past Incidents:\n\n";
                var maxIncidents = 3;
                for (var b = 0; b < Math.min(incidentSearchResults.length, maxIncidents); b++) {
                    var inc = incidentSearchResults[b];
                    var incNumber = "";
                    var incSysId = "";


                    // Extract sys_id and number from columns
                    for (var j = 0; j < inc.columns.length; j++) {
                        var incField = inc.columns[j];
                        if (incField.fieldName === "sys_id") incSysId = incField.value;
                        if (incField.fieldName === "number") incNumber = incField.value;
                    }
                    if (incSysId) {
                        var gr_inc_info = new GlideRecordSecure('incident');
                        if (gr_inc_info.get(incSysId)) {
                            var incDescription = gr_inc_info.description ? gr_inc_info.description.toString() : '';
                            var incCloseNotes = gr_inc_info.close_notes ? gr_inc_info.close_notes.toString() : '';

        // Call GPT (via REST Message or direct endpoint)

            gptClient.setHttpMethod("POST");

            gptClient.setRequestHeader("Content-Type", "application/json");

                "3. Do NOT use '-', '*', bullets, or any other symbols.\n" +
                "4. Do NOT use headings or titles.\n" +
                "5. Keep each step short and simple.\n" +
                "6. Only provide the next steps.\n" +
                "7. Analyze both the provided KB Articles and past Incidents before suggesting steps.\n" +

                "9. Reference a past Incident number in brackets only if it is directly relevant (e.g., INC0012345).\n" +
                "10. If both a KB and an Incident are relevant, reference both appropriately.\n" +
                "11. Do NOT repeat the same KB or Incident number in multiple steps unless absolutely necessary.\n\n";
            gptPrompt += "Incident:\n";
            gptPrompt += "Short Description: " + gr_inc.short_description + "\n";
            gptPrompt += "Description: " + gr_inc.description + "\n";
            gptPrompt += "Category: " + gr_inc.category + "\n";
            gptPrompt += "Subcategory: " + gr_inc.subcategory + "\n";
            gptPrompt += "State: " + gr_inc.state.getDisplayValue() + "\n\n";
            gptPrompt += "jornalnotes" + journal_notes;
            gptPrompt += "Assignement Group :" + gr_inc.assignment_group.getDisplayValue() + "\n\n";
            gptPrompt += "Assigned To: " + (gr_inc.assigned_to.getDisplayValue() || "") + "\n";
            gptPrompt += "Opened At: " + gr_inc.opened_at.getDisplayValue() + "\n";
            gptPrompt += "Location: " + (gr_inc.location.getDisplayValue() || "") + "\n";
            gptPrompt += "Category: " + (gr_inc.category || "") + "\n";
            gptPrompt += "Subcategory: " + (gr_inc.subcategory || "") + "\n";
            gptPrompt += "Company: " + (gr_inc.company.getDisplayValue() || "") + "\n";
            gptPrompt += "Business Service: " + (gr_inc.business_service.getDisplayValue() || "") + "\n";
            gptPrompt += "Configuration Item: " + (gr_inc.cmdb_ci.getDisplayValue() || "") + "\n";
            gptPrompt += kbContent + "\n\n";
            gptPrompt += "Providing the past incidents if any relevent information from these seems useful for resolving the current incident add from these past details and mention its from past incident :" + incidentContent + "\n\n";
            gptPrompt += "Please recommend the most appropriate next step in alignment with ITIL best practices, considering service continuity, stakeholder communication, and root cause analysis" + "\n\n";
            gptPrompt += "Mention KB Article numbers and Incident numbers which are provided in past incident and kb content details";

            var gptPayload = JSON.stringify({
                model: model,
                messages: [{
                    role: "user",
                    content: gptPrompt
                }]
            });

            gptClient.setRequestBody(gptPayload);

            var gptResponse = gptClient.execute();
            var gptBody = gptResponse.getBody();
            var gptResult = JSON.parse(gptBody);
            var suggestion = gptResult.choices[0].message.content;
            var formattedSuggestion = this.convertNumbersToLinks(suggestion);
            return formattedSuggestion;
            //return suggestion;

        } catch (e) {
            return JSON.stringify("Unable to generate suggestion.");
        }
    },

    //function to model the KB and Incident number as hyper links 
    convertNumbersToLinks: function(text) {

        // Handle KB-type numbers
        text = text.replace(/\b(kb|sop|kbscg)\d+\b/gi, function(match) {

            var number = match.toUpperCase(); // normalize

            var grKB = new GlideRecordSecure('kb_knowledge');
            grKB.addQuery('number', number);
            grKB.setLimit(1);
            grKB.query();

            if (grKB.next()) {
                return '<a href="/kb_knowledge.do?sys_id=' + grKB.getUniqueValue() +
                    '" target="_blank" style="text-decoration: none;">' + number + '</a>';
            }
            return number;
        });

        // Handle Incident numbers
        text = text.replace(/\binc\d+\b/gi, function(match) {

            var number = match.toUpperCase(); // normalize

            var grInc = new GlideRecordSecure('incident');
            grInc.addQuery('number', number);
            grInc.setLimit(1);
            grInc.query();

            if (grInc.next()) {
                return '<a href="/incident.do?sys_id=' + grInc.getUniqueValue() +
                    '" target="_blank" style="text-decoration: none;">' + number + '</a>';
            }
            return number;
        });

        text = text.replace(/\r?\n/g, "<br/>");

        return '<div style="font-family: Arial, sans-serif; ' +
            'font-size: 10pt; ' +
            'border: 1px solid #8a8a8a; ' +
            'padding: 8px; ' +
            'background-color: #ffffff;">' +
            text +
            '</div>';
    },

    //function to check the content of short description or description is valid or not
    validateIncidentContent: function(text) {

        if (!text)
            return false;
        try {
            var endpoint = gs.getProperty('azure_openai_endpoint');
            var apiKey = gs.getProperty('azure_openai_key');
            var model = gs.getProperty('azure_openai_model');
            var client = new sn_ws.RESTMessageV2();
            client.setEndpoint(endpoint);
            client.setHttpMethod("POST");
            client.setRequestHeader("Content-Type", "application/json");
            client.setRequestHeader("Authorization", apiKey);

            var prompt = "You are validating an ITSM incident description.\n\n" +
                "If the following text is meaningful and related to a technical issue, return exactly: YES\n" +
                "If it is a greeting, random words, test data, or unrelated content, return exactly: NO\n\n" + "Incident Description:\n" + text;
            var payload = JSON.stringify({
                model: model,
                messages: [{
                    role: "user",
                    content: prompt
                }],
            });

            client.setRequestBody(payload);
            var response = client.execute();
            var result = JSON.parse(response.getBody());
            var answer = result.choices[0].message.content.trim();
            return answer.toUpperCase().indexOf("YES") === 0;

        } catch (e) {
            return false; // safer fallback
        }
    },
